about: Every screenshot the feature pages ask for. Capture each from the real app and save it as static/img/features/<file>. The build renders a <figure> only when the file exists, reading its width and height from the file, so adding a file is the whole swap. n=1 is the hero image at the top of the page; n=2 sits after the steps; n=3 near the end. Fields recapture / recaptureWhy mark a shot whose file exists but no longer matches the app (until it is replaced, the existing image stays on the page); language is the app language to capture in; seed, where given, is the demo data the shot needs.

format.size: Portrait phone screenshot, at least 1080 px wide (for example 1179x2556 from an iPhone 15/16 simulator, or 1080x2400 from an Android emulator). Crop nothing; no device frame.
format.data: Use a demo household for the fictional couple Alex and Sam. No real names, emails, amounts or bank details.
format.theme: Switch Us → Preferences → Appearance to the theme given. Status bar: full battery, 9:41.
